items.title: 6.4.1.3 Peer-to-Peer Network and Its Usage in Blockchain (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Peer-to-peer (P2P) network aisa system hai jis mein computers, jinhein nodes kehte hain, kisi markazi server par bharosa kiye baghair aapas mein seedha rabta karte aur resources share karte hain. Network ka har node client (lene wala) aur server (dene wala) dono ban sakta hai, jis se network zyada mazboot aur decentralized hota hai.

Misal: file-sharing network mein users ek markazi server ki bajaye seedha ek doosre ke computers se files download karte hain. Is se kaam tez aur behtar hota hai, kyunke kai users ek hi waqt mein file ke mukhtalif hisse de sakte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Blockchain mein bhi nodes isi tarah P2P network mein jure hote hain: naya transaction ya block ek node se doosre node tak seedha pohanchta hai, aur har node poori copy rakhta hai. Koi markazi server nahi jise band kar ke network roka ja sake.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain mein P2P networks ka kirdar bataiye: yeh kaise kaam karte hain aur kyun zaroori hain (exercise short question 1)? Blockchain mein P2P network ka bunyadi kaam kya hai (exercise MCQ 16)?
blocks.explanation: (c) Nodes ke darmiyan markazi server ke baghair seedha data share karna. Har node naye transactions aur blocks leta aur aage bhejta hai, ledger ki poori copy rakhta hai aur blocks ko qawaid ke mutabiq jaanchta hai. Zaroori is liye ke koi markazi server nahi jis ki kharabi ya qabze se nizam ruk jaye; kuch nodes kharab hon tab bhi network chalta rehta hai; aur bohat si copies hone se chhed chhaar pakri jati hai.

items: P2P: nodes baghair markazi server ke seedha rabta aur sharing; har node client bhi, server bhi.
Misal: file-sharing; blockchain ki decentralized banawat ki bunyad.
